svg.title: Atlantic South Equatorial Undercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 2800 km. Declared western-to-central Atlantic subsurface reach from the 35 W section near 3 S to an OSW truncation near 10 W, 4.3 S. Uses the published float-study domain, not full-current start and termination. Excludes westward SEC legs, NBUC source pathways, recirculation loops, surface drift and uncertain central/eastern continuation. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate 200 m context western-to-central studied reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Fischer et al. (2008), sec. 2 and 4; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
